comments.author: yuri
comments.text: Implementation status: all seven subcommands (answer assign send tool spawn kill archive) wired in bin.ts tree with real bodies. Shared helpers: resolve.ts prefix resolution (unique prefixes, ambiguous w/ candidates in detail, not_found), pick_session.ts targeting, hub_ops.ts runOp/listOp/toolBudgetMs over ctx.cmd (DI-stubbable), cmd_mutation_helpers.ts failWith/failReply channel. Per-command bodies emit spec envelopes (--json shapes per docs/03 Subcommands) and human confirmations. Picker requires TTY, machine modes never prompt (kill consent matrix: --yes skips; non-TTY/machine without --yes = usage 1, never assumes consent). tool strict [json] parse fail = usage 1; budget max(replyTimeoutMs, wait*1000). archive LIST reads archive/YYYY-MM/*.json with no socket. Tests: 24 new contract tests in commands.test.ts (in-process fake hub socket + captured run()); bin.test.ts config-resolution tests now exercise a fake hub end-to-end (answer reaches hub, not_found envelope). Full workspace: 233 tests green, tsc --noEmit clean, bun build clean.
